g.text: CAN connector pinout is identical on both JST-GH headers. Twist CANH/CANL. Pin 4 is shield/drain provision and is not a power conductor.

g.text: CAN_STB (PB10) has a pull-up: standby through reset. Configure FDCAN TX recessive before driving STB low. Fit termination only at bus ends.
